rv.q: All in all, Beauty and the Beast remains a heartfelt family musical filled with magical moments.
What is doesn't need are the bloated, interminably long dance numbers that are out of place and unnecessary.
In general, the show’s virtues continue to shine.
Overall, the production was visually stunning and the acting mirrored the movie.

cn.t: The 30th anniversary tour delivers nostalgic Disney magic with beloved music and modern touches that delight families and introduce a new generation to the classic tale.
